verdict.rationale: Fellow's MCP Server and 'Ask Fellow' feature let users query meeting data ('What were my action items this week?') via natural language without code, and this works across AI tools like Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor. However, evidence mostly covers read-style querying rather than full agentic command execution (e.g., no clear proof that natural-language commands can trigger writes like updating notes or completing action items via MCP, only via REST API). missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven write/action commands through MCP, independent hands-on confirmation of the natural-language experience.
